roles.title: Software Engineer I
points: Building a multi-user agentic RAG chat app in Go, with multilingual support and document ingestion.
Cut p95 latency 300ms → 33ms (9× faster) with indexing and Redis caching.
Automated reminders with Celery workers, cutting manual staff work by 80%.

roles.title: Full Stack Engineer
points: Raised throughput 45% by moving slow GraphQL work to BullMQ workers.
Added a Redis cache that answers ~78% of lookups.
Streamed LLM replies: first response in 1.2s instead of ~8s.

roles.title: Backend Engineer
points: Cut p95 latency 270ms → 180ms with query optimisation, indexing and Redis caching.
Built an idempotent payment gateway, so a retried request never charges twice.
Retried failed payments with BullMQ, cutting the failure rate by 60%.
